entry.title: FEET ONLY — Neon Pulse | Easy Rhythm Challenge · Immersive Interactive Workout

media:group.media:title: FEET ONLY — Neon Pulse | Easy Rhythm Challenge · Immersive Interactive Workout
media:group.media:description:
Step to the beat and follow the rhythm! 👣
NEON PULSE is an easy FEET ONLY interactive workout designed for beginners and anyone who wants a simple, fun way to move with the music.
Start with a short warm-up, then follow the yellow and pink foot cues as they move toward you. No complicated moves. No obstacles. Just stay on beat and keep moving!
🎮 HOW TO PLAY • Follow the foot cues on screen • Step left or right to match the tiles • Keep your movement in rhythm with the beat • Most importantly — have fun!
⚡ MODE: FEET ONLY 🟢 DIFFICULTY: EASY 🎵 STAGE: NEON PULSE
No equipment needed.
